changelog: Delete: the dashboard's '🚨 3 consecutive losses -- review your setups before the next trade' banner (AlertController::getAlerts(), the non-same-day branch of the consecutive-losses check) and its logic -- not replaced. The calculator's live status strip (v3.17.0) is now the one place trade-limit signals live. The separate same-day '🛑 3 consecutive losses TODAY' danger banner was not named in this briefing and is kept
Fix: the Current Streak card read '4 Losss' for a 4-loss streak -- plain +'s' doesn't pluralize 'Loss'. Now 'Losses' for a loss streak, 'Wins' (already correct) for a win streak

Verify: an existing Open trade's planned_margin field (added v3.17.0) correctly shows blank -- not hidden, not locked -- when editing a trade saved before that column existed, so a margin can be entered retroactively. No code change was needed: the field was never part of TradeController::saveJournal()'s pre-entry lock (that only applies once a trade closes) and openTradeModal()'s population loop already leaves it blank rather than erroring on a null value
